label: ↔️ Forward / backward fill
description: Fill nulls by carrying the previous (forward fill) or next (backward fill) value. Most useful for time-series where missing readings should inherit from the prior reading. Optional sort + group preserves per-entity locality.

sortColumn.label: Sort column (optional)
sortColumn.help: Sort rows by this column (e.g. date) before filling so 'forward' = chronological.

groupColumn.label: Group column (optional)
groupColumn.help: Fill within each group separately (e.g. per device, per customer).
